faq_heading: Furry Creek homes: your questions answered

faq.a: On the east shore of Howe Sound along the Sea-to-Sky Highway (Highway 99), between Lions Bay and Squamish. The MLS® files it under West Vancouver, but it is not part of the District of West Vancouver. It sits in the Squamish-Lillooet Regional District.

faq.q: How many homes sell in Furry Creek?
faq.a: Very few. The MLS® recorded 4 sales between November 1, 2025 and October 22, 2026: 1 house and 3 townhomes. With so few sales a price from one year says little, so look at the listings in front of you.

faq.q: What kinds of homes are in Furry Creek?
faq.a: Townhomes, mainly at Oliver’s Landing, and land. There are no apartment-condo buildings.

faq.q: Who provides services in Furry Creek?
faq.a: The Squamish-Lillooet Regional District. Water, sewer, dyking, fire and street lighting are SLRD local services rather than a city’s.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Written from the Furry Creek guide (checked November 1, 2026) and Paragon closed sales to October 22, 2026. The live search is connected.

Furry Creek is a master-planned community on the east shore of Howe Sound along Highway 99, between Lions Bay and Squamish. It is unincorporated and sits in Electoral Area D of the Squamish-Lillooet Regional District (SLRD), so there is no city hall: the SLRD sets the zoning and runs the local services.

This search lists homes for sale in Furry Creek. Very few sell. Between November 1, 2025 and October 22, 2026, the MLS® recorded 4 sales here (1 house and 3 townhomes), so the search often shows only a few homes at a time, and no median price is shown on this page because a median needs at least 5 sales.

items.t: Townhomes. Oliver’s Landing, the waterfront strata on Beach Drive, Whitecap Court and Point Terrace, is the main townhome complex, and its last phase was still going through development permits in 2025.
Land. Lots and land trade here under the SLRD’s Furry Creek zones. The land buying rules page explains the checks.
Condos. Furry Creek has no apartment-condo buildings, so a condo search here will usually be empty.

blocks.text: Rules that apply in Furry Creek

items.t: There is no municipal bylaw set. Zoning is the SLRD Electoral Area D Zoning Bylaw No. 1350-2016, and the Furry Creek zones include CD3 and the FCR residential zones.

The extra 3 to 6 unit densities allowed elsewhere in BC do not apply. The Province determined that Furry Creek is not within an urban containment boundary, and SLRD Amendment Bylaw No. 1887-2025 removed the extra densities that had briefly been added.
Water, sewer, dyking, fire and street lighting are SLRD local services, so ask what each costs and who provides it before you offer.
